arguments.summary: Fixed issue #23 in cfg/loader.py: load_config now iterates over `env`, and for each key starting with `APP_` it overrides the matching lowercased key in the returned copy of `defaults`, coercing the string value to the default's type via a `_coerce` helper (bool accepts 1/true/yes/on case-insensitively; int/float/str use the built-in constructors). Verified with the existing test suite (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`, 1 test OK) plus a manual check covering int, float, bool, and str overrides.
